name.label: Profile Name
name.description: The name shown in the profile selector.

icon.label: Profile Icon
icon.description: The icon shown in the profile selector.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.description: Re-encode at exact scene boundaries, or stream-copy with boundaries snapped to keyframes.

openLocation.label: Open file location after export
openLocation.description: Open the folder and highlight the file when an export finishes.

container.label: Container
container.description: The file format: MP4 or MOV.

codec.label: Codec
codec.description: The video codec used when exporting.

profile.label: Codec Profile
profile.description: Quality and compression level for that codec.

audio.label: Audio Codec
audio.description: Re-encode the audio, copy it as it is, or drop it.

encoder.label: Video Encoder
encoder.cpuOnly: This codec can only be encoded on the CPU.
encoder.usingGpu: Using your {{backend}} GPU. Auto falls back to the CPU if it fails.
encoder.usingGpuWithEncoder: Using your {{backend}} GPU ({{encoder}}). Auto falls back to the CPU if it fails.
encoder.gpuUnsupported: Your GPU can't encode this codec, so Auto uses the CPU.
encoder.noGpu: No GPU encoder found, so Auto uses the CPU.

parallel.label: Parallel Encodes
parallel.locked: Only available on GPUs that can run more than one encode at a time.
parallel.description_one: How many exports run at the same time. This codec supports up to {{count}}.
parallel.description_other: How many exports run at the same time. This codec supports up to {{count}}.

icons.cropHint: Use a square crop for best icon quality

depth.label: Depth map pass
depth.description: Also save a depth map of each export as <name>_depth.
depth.descriptionOff: Also save a depth map of each export as <name>_depth. Turn it on in Settings › Features.

model.label: Depth model
model.description: Bigger models look better but take longer.

colormap.label: Colormap
colormap.description: Color palette for the depth map.

grayscale.label: Grayscale
grayscale.description: Use black and white instead of a color palette.

upscale.label: Upscale pass
upscale.description: Also save a higher resolution copy of each export as <name>_upscaled.
upscale.descriptionOff: Also save a higher resolution copy of each export as <name>_upscaled. Turn it on in Settings › Features.

model.label: Upscale model
model.description: All are trained on anime. Downloads the first time you use it.

quality.label: File quality
quality.description: How the upscaled video is compressed. Outputs are always H.264.

features.title: Features

aiSceneDetection.label: AI Scene Detection
aiSceneDetection.description: Finds scene cuts with AI (TransNetV2), the most accurate way to import.

sceneScout.label: Scene Scout
sceneScout.description: Search your episodes by describing a scene, and find clips that match each other.

depthPass.label: Depth Map Pass
depthPass.description: Creates a depth map of each exported file.

upscalePass.label: Upscale Pass
upscalePass.description: Creates a higher resolution copy of each exported file with AI.

hideDisabled.label: Hide disabled features
hideDisabled.description: Remove switched-off features from the app instead of greying them out.

features.lockedByImport: Setting disabled while imports are running

gpu.cpuWithNvidia: The CPU version is installed, but this PC has an NVIDIA GPU. AI features are running much slower than they could.
gpu.cpuInstalled: The CPU version is installed. If this PC has an NVIDIA GPU, reinstalling with GPU support makes AI features much faster.

packages.label: AI packages
packages.description: PyTorch, every feature's packages, and the Python they run on.

passModels.label: Pass model weights
passModels.description: Depth and upscale models you downloaded under Model weights.

scoutModel.label: Scene Scout model
scoutModel.description: SigLIP 2, kept in the shared Hugging Face cache, so other apps that use it share this copy.

previewCache.label: Preview cache
previewCache.description: Playable previews of Scene Scout results and Match clips. Kept under 1 GB automatically, oldest first, and remade when needed.

total.label: Total
total.description: Everything the AI features use on this PC.

uninstall.label: Uninstall AI features
uninstall.description: Deletes the AI packages and switches the AI features off. Model weights are kept; delete them under Model weights.

features.devBuild: Dev build: AI features run from the AMVerge-CLI checkout's venv, so nothing is downloaded or removed from here.

scenepacksOff.title: Disable Scenepacks
scenepacksOff.message_one: You have {{count}} Scenepack. Would you like to delete it too, or just disable the feature and keep it for later?
scenepacksOff.message_other: You have {{count}} Scenepacks. Would you like to delete them too, or just disable the feature and keep them for later?

models.description: Model weights used by this feature. Download them ahead of time for fast offline exporting.

turnOn.depth: Turn on the depth pass above to manage its models.
turnOn.upscale: Turn on the upscale pass above to manage its models.
